description: This file defines utility classes and functions for interacting with the Ollama language model server, including error handling (OllamaError), image conversion (_convert_image), and a class (OllamaModelInfo) for retrieving and managing available models from the Ollama server.

classes.name: OllamaError
classes.description: Custom exception class for Ollama-related errors, inheriting from BaseLLMException.

classes.name: OllamaModelInfo
classes.description: Class providing methods to retrieve, list, and validate models from the Ollama server, including environment configurations.

methods.name: _convert_image(image)
methods.description: Converts an image to base64 JPEG format if not already in base64 or in PNG/JPEG format.

methods.name: OllamaModelInfo.get_api_key
methods.description: Retrieves the API key from environment variables, litellm configuration, or secret manager.

methods.name: OllamaModelInfo.get_api_base
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL from parameter, secret manager, or defaults to localhost.

methods.name: OllamaModelInfo.get_models
methods.description: Fetches the list of available models from Ollama server via /api/tags endpoint.

methods.name: OllamaModelInfo.validate_environment
methods.description: Performs validation of the environment; currently a no-op.

methods.name: OllamaModelInfo.get_base_model
methods.description: Returns the base model name; currently a no-op.

methods.name: __init__( self, status_code: int, message: str, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
List[str] get_models(self, api_key=None, api_base: Optional[str] = None)
dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: list, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key=None, api_base=None, )
